description: Header file defining functions and classes for efficient string set lookup using DAFSA (Deterministic Acyclic Finite State Automaton). Includes external references to string_piece and net_export, and defines a class FixedSetIncrementalLookup and related functions for fixed set membership and suffix lookup.

classes.name: FixedSetIncrementalLookup
classes.description: Class providing incremental, space-efficient lookup of fixed string sets, supporting prefix and suffix queries.

methods.name: LookupStringInFixedSet
methods.description: Performs a fast lookup to determine if a string is in a fixed set, returning a status code.

methods.name: LookupSuffixInReversedSet
methods.description: Finds the longest matching suffix in a reversed DAFSA for a given host string.

methods.name: FixedSetIncrementalLookup
methods.description: Constructor initializing the lookup with a graph representing the fixed set.

methods.name: Advance
methods.description: Advances the lookup state with an input character, returning whether the sequence is still in the set or a prefix.

methods.name: GetResultForCurrentSequence
methods.description: Returns the result code for the current input sequence in the lookup automaton.
